title: NOAA National Water Model Channel Routing Output
variables_text: Runoff From Bottom Of Soil To Bucket, Flux From Gw Bucket, Runoff From Terrain Routing, Runoff Into Channel Reach, River Flow, River Velocity
description: Contains simulated flow and channel-related variables for river and stream segments, representing the movement of water through the channel network.
notes: Query types: area, cube, items, locations. 6 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://noaa-nwm-retrospective-3-0-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#CONUS/zarr/chrtout.zarr/. Documentation: https://registry.opendata.aws/nwm-archive/. Methodology: https://hdsc.nws.noaa.gov/pub/hdsc/data/papers/articles/HRL_Pubs_PDF_May12_2009/HRL_PUBS_201-250/206_CHANNEL_ROUTING,_HYDROLOGICAL_FORECASTING.pdf. Keywords: NWM.

title: NOAA National Water Model Land Data Assimilation System Output
variables_text: Accumulated Total Evapotranspiration, Accumulated Melting Water Out Of Snow Bottom, Surface Albedo, Snowpack Albedo, Direct, Snowpack Albedo, Diffuse, Cosine Of Zenith Angle, Direct From Soil Evaporation Rate, Total Net Lw Radiation To Atmosphere, Total Absorbed Sw Radiation, Snow-Cover Fraction On The Ground, Total Sensible Heat To The Atmosphere, Total Latent Heat To The Atmosphere, Rainfall Rate On The Ground, Snowfall Rate On The Ground, Snow Water Equivalent, Snow Depth, Volumetric Soil Moisture, The Dimensionless Ratio Of Water Volume (M3) To Soil Volume (M3), Liquid Volumetric Soil Moisture, Surface Radiative Temperature, Accumulated Underground Runoff
description: Aims to produce high quality fields of land surface states and fluxes by integrating satellite and ground-based observational data products
notes: Query types: cube. 20 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://noaa-nwm-retrospective-3-0-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#CONUS/zarr/ldasout.zarr/. Documentation: https://registry.opendata.aws/nwm-archive/. Keywords: NWM.

title: NOAA National Water Model Reach to Reach Routing Output
variables_text: Surface Head, Depth To Saturation, Rounded To Highest Saturated Layer
description: Provides simulated streamflow and related hydrologic variables for millions of individual river and stream reaches across the U.S., representing how water is routed downstream through the national river network.
notes: Query types: cube. 2 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://noaa-nwm-retrospective-3-0-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#CONUS/zarr/rtout.zarr/. Documentation: https://registry.opendata.aws/nwm-archive/. Keywords: NWM.

title: NOAA National Water Model Lake Output
variables_text: Lake Inflow, Lake Outflow, Water Surface Elevation
description: Provides simulated water levels, storage, and outflows for lakes and reservoirs across the U.S. It delivers time-series data that supports monitoring, forecasting, and management of lake and reservoir conditions within the hydrologic network.
notes: Query types: area, cube, items, locations. 3 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://noaa-nwm-retrospective-3-0-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#CONUS/zarr/lakeout.zarr/. Documentation: https://registry.opendata.aws/nwm-archive/. Keywords: NWM.

title: NOAA National Water Model Groundwater Output
variables_text: Bucket Depth, Bucket Inflow, Bucket Outflow
description: Provides data on the flux of water that moves from the modeled groundwater system into the surface water system or out of the groundwater storage component. The geometry for each item is the centroid of the associated NHD Plus catchment.
notes: Query types: area, cube, items, locations. 3 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://noaa-nwm-retrospective-3-0-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html#CONUS/zarr/gwout.zarr/. Documentation: https://registry.opendata.aws/nwm-archive/. Keywords: NWM.

title: USACE Access2Water API
variables_text: Elevation, Inflow, Elevation Tailwater, Dissolved Oxygen, Water Temperature, Air Temperature, Precipitation, Flood Storage, Power Generation, Outflow, Surcharge Release, Conservation Storage, Stage, Percent Flood Pool, Percent Conservation Pool, Stage Tailwater, Elevation Rule Curve, Wind Direction, Wind Speed, Evaporation, Irradiance, Voltage
description: Provides a subset of the USACE Corps Water Management System (CWMS) API specifically focused on water control management data
notes: Query types: area, cube, items, locations. 22 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://cwms-data.usace.army.mil/cwms-data/swagger-ui.html. Documentation: https://water.usace.army.mil/. Keywords: open data.

title: USDA Snowpack Telemetry Network (SNOTEL)
variables_text: Air Temperature Average, Air Temperature Maximum, Air Temperature Minimum, Air Temperature Observed, Barometric Pressure, Battery, Battery Average, Battery Maximum, Battery Minimum, Battery-ETI Precip Guage, Conductivity, Dew Point Temperature, Discharge Manual/External Adjusted Mean, Dissolved Oxygen, Dissolved Oxygen - Percent Saturation, Diversion Discharge Observed Mean, Diversion Flow Volume Observed, Ground heat flux, Evaporation, Fuel Moisture, Internal Fuel Temperature, Voltage, Ground Surface Interface Temperature Average, Maximum ground surface temperature, Minimum ground surface temperature, Ground surface temperature (observed), Leaf wetness duration, Net Solar Radiation Average, Net Solar Radiation Maximum, Net Solar Radiation Minimum, Net Solar Radiation Observed, pH, Photosynthetically Active Radiation Average, Precipitation Accumulation, Precipitation Increment, Precipitation increment - snow-adjusted, Precipitation Month-to-date, Profile Temperature, Precipitation (ETI), Radiation Incoming Longwave Average, … (116 parameters in all)
description: Is an automated system of snowpack and related climate sensors primarily in mountainous regions in the Western United States which aims to collect data like snow water equivalent, accumulated precipitation, and air temperature.

title: USDA Air and Water Database (AWDB) Forecasts
description: Provides predictions for climate and water supply conditions. It uses the same endpoint as SNOTEL but includes only forecasts
notes: Query types: area, cube, items, locations. 2 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://wcc.sc.egov.usda.gov/awdbRestApi/swagger-ui/index.html. Documentation: https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/wps/portal/wcc/home/aboutUs/monitoringPrograms/automatedSnowMonitoring/. Keywords: EDR, AWDB, USDA.

title: NOAA River Forecast Center Seasonal Forecasts
description: Aggregates water supply forecast data from all regional NOAA river forecast centers into one collection.
notes: Query types: items. Upstream source: https://www.cnrfc.noaa.gov/ensembleProduct.php ; https://www.cbrfc.noaa.gov/lmap/lmap.php ; https://www.nwrfc.noaa.gov/rfc/. Documentation: https://www.cbrfc.noaa.gov/wsup/graph/west/map/esp_map.html. Keywords: NOAA.

title: USGS Parameter-elevation Regressions on Independent Slopes Model (PRISM)
variables_text: Mean monthly precipitation, Minimum monthly temperature, Maximum monthly temperature
description: Provides a raster for high-resolution spatial climate data, including precipitation, temperature, and other climate variables, derived by combining point-based weather observations with digital elevation and other geographic information. Hosted by USGS; originally generated by Oregon State University
notes: Query types: cube, position. 3 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://usgs.osn.mghpcc.org/mdmf/gdp/PRISM_v2.zarr. Documentation: https://prism.oregonstate.edu/. Methodology: https://code.usgs.gov/wma/nhgf/geo-data-portal/gdp_data_processing/-/blob/main/workflows/opendap/CIDA/PRISM_v2/prism_processing2_update.py?ref_type=heads. Keywords: temperature, precipitation.

title: USGS National Map 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
description: Provides nationwide topographic elevation data, including bare-earth digital elevation models (DEMs) and derivative products such as hillshades, contours, and 3D surface models.
notes: Query types: map. Upstream source: https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer. Documentation: https://www.usgs.gov/3d-elevation-program. Keywords: USGS.

title: USGS National Map Land Cover as of 2019
description: Provides a raster for classification of land cover types across the Contiguous United States (CONUS), including forests, wetlands, urban areas, agricultural lands, and water bodies. It is derived from satellite imagery and other remote sensing data
notes: Query types: map. Upstream source: https://www.mrlc.gov/geoserver/NLCD_Land_Cover/wms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities. Documentation: https://www.usgs.gov/centers/eros/science/national-land-cover-database. Keywords: USGS.

title: USGS Principal Aquifers in the Colorado Basin States
description: Contains data from the Ground Water Atlas of the United States (published as part of the National Atlas in 1998, revised 2003) and indicates the areal extent of the uppermost principal aquifers on a national scale.
notes: Query types: items. Upstream source: https://services3.arcgis.com/0OPQIK59PJJqLK0A/arcgis/rest/services/Aquifers_USGS_West/FeatureServer/0. Keywords: aquifers.

title: Arizona Department of Water Resources Active Management Areas
description: Contains designated groundwater-management zones where water withdrawals are under regulatory oversight to address overdraft and ensure long-term sustainability
notes: Query types: items. Upstream source: https://services3.arcgis.com/0OPQIK59PJJqLK0A/ArcGIS/rest/services/Active_Managment_Areas_2025/FeatureServer/0. Documentation: https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/71bc84edbbf9424f9ceb2116acc6bf5a ; https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=cf795fe0b23e4afc99728d1b97dd1253. Keywords: management.

title: Arizona Department of Water Resources Groundwater Basins
description: Contains the list of groundwater basins in Arizona. According to ARS 45-402(13) "Groundwater basin" means an area which, as nearly as known facts permit as determined by the director pursuant to this chapter, may be designated so as to enclose a relatively hydrologically distinct body or related bodies of groundwater, which shall be described horizontally by surface description.
notes: Query types: items. Upstream source: https://services.arcgis.com/C34zQ7veRS0V1t04/ArcGIS/rest/services/Groundwater_Basin/FeatureServer/0. Documentation: https://www.arcgis.com/apps/webappviewer/index.html?id=b84f6d906be94505b25d68d6af3b02ca. Keywords: groundwater.

variables_text: Total Profile Soil Moisture (0 Cm To Model Bedrock Depth), Total Profile Soil Moisture (0 Cm To Model Bedrock Depth; Percentile Units), Total Profile Soil Wetness (0 Cm To Model Bedrock Depth; Wetness Units). notes: Query types: cube. 8 parameter(s). Upstream source: https://nsidc.org/data/data-access-tool/SPL4SMGP/versions/8. Documentation: https://nsidc.org/data/spl4smgp/versions/8. Keywords: NASA.

title: Arizona Department of Water Resources Irrigation Districts
description: Contains boundaries for irrigation districts across Arizona. Irrigation Districts are municipal corporations and political subdivisions established as a special taxing district for either agricultural improvement or irrigation and conservation purposes. Irrigation Districts receive, pump, and distribute water to irrigated lands within their service area. - Arizona Department of Water Resources
notes: Query types: items. Upstream source: https://services.arcgis.com/C34zQ7veRS0V1t04/ArcGIS/rest/services/Irrigation_District_2024/FeatureServer/0. Documentation: https://www.azwater.gov/ama/agriculture-program. Keywords: groundwater.

title: Central Arizona Project (CAP) Diversion Canal
description: Contains the geospatial boundaries of the canal, which diverts water from the Colorado River at the Bill Williams Wildlife Refuge south portion of Lake Havasu near Parker into central and southern Arizona. CAP is managed and operated by the Central Arizona Water Conservation District (CAWCD). Each canal section is labeled with a unique identifier.
notes: Query types: items. Upstream source: https://services.arcgis.com/C34zQ7veRS0V1t04/ArcGIS/rest/services/CAP_2024/FeatureServer/0. Keywords: groundwater.

title: GRACE/FO-derived Lower Colorado Basin Groundwater Storage Levels Changes
description: Contains a processed version of the CSR GRACE/GRACE-FO RL06.3 Mascon Solutions (RL0603) for the Lower Colorado River Basin, aggregated monthly for trends in groundwater storage changes.
notes: Query types: items, area, cube, locations. 1 parameter(s). Documentation: https://opengw.netlify.app/. Keywords: groundwater, asu, GRACE.

title: GRACE/FO-derived GWS change by Arizona Groundwater Basin from 2003-2023
description: Contains a processed version of the CSR GRACE/GRACE-FO RL06.3 Mascon Solutions (RL0603) for each Arizona Groundwater Basin. Each basin has one value `gws` which represents the change in groundwater storage for that basin for the period 2003-2023.
notes: Query types: items. Documentation: https://opengw.netlify.app/. Keywords: groundwater, GRACE.
